status.current_name: Vassar Labs IT Solutions Private Limited
status.main_product: aquaWISE and aquaCITY digital water/utility management platforms
status.scope_reason: The company provides aquaCITY, a smart city urban water utility platform incorporating digital twin and IoT technologies for network and infrastructure monitoring.
status.evidence: According to corporate registry data via InstaFinancials, Vassar Labs IT Solutions Private Limited is active as of 2026, and its product page shows it delivers the aquaCITY digital twin platform for urban water supply and services.

claims.claim: The company reports that its aquaCITY platform connects the urban water utility "Source-to-Tap" journey, integrating a digital twin module that monitors water transmission/distribution infrastructure, 3,698 km of networks, 10+ water treatment plants, and pumping stations in real time using IoT sensors and SCADA data.
claims.note: The specific list of infrastructure components monitored in real time ('3,698 km of networks, 10+ water treatment plants, and pumping stations') is not confirmed to be part of a real-time 'digital twin module' description in claim 1.

claims.claim: The company reports that its aquaWISE platform (Enterprise version) integrates a 3D engine alongside its generative AI suite for state and country-scale digital twin infrastructure deployments.

The company reports that its aquaCITY digital twin platform combines GIS-based infrastructure datasets with live IoT sensors, SCADA information, and satellite/Earth observation data to manage urban water systems across 7 Indian cities, covering approximately 3,698 km of distribution network and 10+ Water Treatment Plants.

The company reports publishing a technical paper titled "Application of Remote Sensing, AI & ML in Smart Irrigation" in the ICID Digest 2026 (April–June Edition), authored by Mr. Nikhilesh Kumar and Dr. Madhuri Rampalli, which explores the integration of AI, remote sensing, and digital twin technology for water resource infrastructure.

The company reports that its aquaCITY digital twin platform for urban water management is rolled out across 7 cities (and operates across 8+ major Indian cities), serving 1.35 million citizens, and it lists the Karnataka Urban Water Management System and Andhra Pradesh Digital Municipal Administrations as active deployments.
claims.note: The specific active deployment lists ('Karnataka Urban Water Management System and Andhra Pradesh Digital Municipal Administrations') are not fully verified as active deployments under these exact names for aquaCITY in the sources.

claims.claim: The company has signed a contract with the Government of Andhra Pradesh for the APWRIMS 2.0 (Andhra Pradesh Water Resources Information and Management System) contract for water auditing and comprehensive water planning.

According to the official financial filings of Vassar Labs IT Solutions Private Limited, the company reported total operational revenue of INR 25,42,70,938 for the financial year ending March 31, 2022, up from INR 15,07,28,074 in the previous fiscal year.

The company reports that its aquaCITY digital twin platform operates across 8+ major Indian cities, managing over 100,000 households and 1.45 lakh GIS-mapped assets, leading to 40% revenue growth for client utilities.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its aquaCITY digital twin platform operates across 7 cities, covering approximately 497.74 MLD of water treatment capacity, 10+ Water Treatment Plants, 3,698 km of distribution network, 160+ water-supply zones and 280+ wards.

claims.claim: The company reports the implementation of its digital water management platform for 8+ cities under the Karnataka Urban Water Management System, deploying its aquaCITY digital twin solution to track 1.45 lakh GIS-mapped assets and manage 1,60,556 GIS-mapped house service connections.
claims.corrected: The company reports the implementation of its digital water management platform for 7 cities, deploying its aquaCITY digital twin solution to track 3,58,337 GIS-mapped water utility assets and manage 1,60,556 GIS-mapped house service connections.

claims.claim: The company reports the deployment of a state-scale digital twin framework for the world's largest lift irrigation project spanning an 1832 Km water network as well as the Narmada Integrated Reservoir Operations.

Vassar Labs celebrated a collaboration with the Delhi Research Implementation and Innovation (DRIIV) ecosystem in 2026 to work together on AI, advanced technology solutions, technology consulting, and digital transformation initiatives.
Vassar Labs showcased an AI-focused collaboration with RailTel at the AI Impact Summit Expo 2026 in Delhi to highlight their technical presence and joint ecosystem engagement.
claims.corrected: Vassar Labs showcased an AI-focused collaboration with RailTel at the India AI Expo 2026 in Delhi to highlight their technical presence and joint ecosystem engagement.
claims.source: RailTel Official Social Media Announcements & Press Updates (February 2026)

claims.claim: The company has rolled out its aquaCITY digital twin platform across 7 major Indian cities, mapping 3,58,337 water utility assets and 1,60,556 GIS-based household connections to manage approximately 497.74 MLD of water treatment capacity.
claims.source: Vassar Labs Official Blog & Article "Digital Water Management for Urban Utilities" (September 2026)

claims.claim: The company's platform has been deployed at a state scale for the Urban Water Management System for Karnataka and has been implemented in a project spanning 121 urban local bodies.
claims.corrected: The company's platform has been deployed at a state scale for the Urban Water Management System for Karnataka and has been implemented in a project spanning 8 urban local bodies.
